title: Local systemd unit required active state

observation_kinds.name: systemd_unit_state_snapshot
observation_kinds.description: The system manager's load, active and sub state for one exact unit in one cut

coverage.name: systemd_unit_state
coverage.description: The manager-reported state of the requested unit

scope_kinds.name: systemd_unit
scope_kinds.description: One exact machine identity and one canonical system-manager unit name

vantages.name: local
vantages.description: Observation from a process on the machine whose system manager is read

access_paths.name: systemd_dbus
access_paths.description: Read-only calls to org.freedesktop.systemd1 on the local system bus

bases.name: manager_snapshot
bases.description: A bounded system-manager unit state snapshot

regimes.name: normal
regimes.description: Read-only observation that starts, stops, reloads or enqueues nothing

capabilities.name: read_systemd_unit
capabilities.description: Read the machine identity and one unit's state from the system manager

disturbance_assumptions: Reading unit state loads an unloaded unit into manager memory, as systemctl show does; it changes no unit state, job, file or configuration
One manager cut establishes the reported unit state only; it is not a service operational, reachability, dependency, or application health claim
